evidence.observation: H701 reads 422.341 °C while H702 reads 82.323 °C and the reboiler vessel reads 71.743 °C; the large heater-temperature discrepancy warrants verification.
The discrepancy persists: H701 is 425.353 °C, H702 is 83.498 °C, and the vessel is 73.519 °C; these readings do not distinguish actual local overheating from a temperature-measurement fault.
Distillate, reflux, and cooling-water flows remain nonzero at 0.272, 0.301, and 7.286 respectively; they do not independently validate the H701 temperature.
